as_told.title: 'Norton Air Force Base internal' PDF on Greer's DPI archive

plain: A man named Brad Sorensen is said to have described alien reproduction vehicles, man-made craft copied from alien ones, being built from the late 1950s at Norton Air Force Base in California. The UFO campaigner Steven Greer says he has a full transcript of Sorensen talking about this with an aerospace writer. A researcher who goes by UAPGerb, which is short for unidentified anomalous phenomena, the government's term for UFOs, describes the same file differently: as a PDF called "Norton Air Force Base internal", posted to an online document archive known as DPI, dated 1990, with the writer named as Bill Scott. If true, it would mean the US was building copies of alien craft decades ago.
